title: The hospital parking lot, ii
logline: Tuesday. The lot again. The sign, the different kind. Gully's flatbed pulls in beside the Datsun with a sack. Two sacks. The strip is about the count.

panels.composition: A hospital parking lot, evening, sodium light, a sign the strip draws as a blue H on white and nothing else. The Datsun. WOOD inside. BARNABY in the passenger seat.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a hospital parking lot at evening under sodium light with a plain blue-H sign, a rusted small car with a man and a dog inside, no building shown
image.notes: Never the building. The sign is the only tell.

panels.composition: Gully's flatbed pulling in beside. GULLY getting out with two grease sacks.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a flatbed truck pulling in beside a small car in a parking lot and a man in a canvas jacket getting out with two paper grease sacks

panels.composition: Through the Datsun's window: Gully handing one sack in. Keeping one. Sitting on the flatbed's tailgate to eat it.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a man handing a grease sack through a car window and sitting on his truck's tailgate with his own, evening

panels.composition: The lot. The two vehicles. Two men eating. The dog with a fry. The H. The building, still not drawn.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a hospital parking lot at night with a small car and a flatbed side by side, two men eating from paper sacks and a dog with a french fry, a blue-H sign, no words

art.palette: limited, muddy; Sundays in watercolor, improving

notes: Two sacks. Gully eats his in the lot. The building never drawn.
